Rokta Hai Kyun Humein Tu Matam e Shabir Se
Jab Ke Sabit Hai Yeh Matam Zainab-e-Dilgeer Se.

1
Jab Khuda Ki Zaat Pe Zima Azadari Ka Hai.
Phir Kahan Rukti Hai Yeh Fatwoon Ke Taig-o-Teer Se.
Kya Biyaan Ho Unn Ki Azmat Jo Madina Se Chalay.
Hur Bana Dala Ossay Jo Aa Gaya Takheer Se.

2
Aik Iqrar-e-Wilayat Aik Matam Shah Ka.
Kam Hote Hain Yeh Dono Khon Ki Taseer Se.
Iss Liye Sajjad Ki Aankhoon Se Khon Rukta Nahi.
Sari Mastorein Bandhi Hain Aik Hi Zanjeer Se.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/rokta-hai-kyun-humein-tu-matam-e-shabir-se-tajpoints-4003e7a1433d112d39ee.md\")
_, header, body = p.read_text().split(\"---\\n\", 2)
roman = header.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)[1]
for verse, labels in [(roman, (\"1\", \"2\")), (body, (\"۱\", \"۲\"))]:
    blocks = verse.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
    assert len(blocks) == 3
    assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in blocks] == [2, 5, 5]
    assert tuple(b.splitlines()[0].strip() for b in blocks[1:]) == labels
    assert all(not l.endswith(\".\") for l in verse.splitlines())
assert \"\\u200c\" not in body and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in header and \"noUrdu\" not in header
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 10 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the opening couplet and both four-line stanzas align. Added the Urdu title, set the direction to `rtl`, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Kam” as **کام**.
